title: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
abstract: arXiv:2502.04356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications. Open models have substantial potential to improve healthcare applications. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and a taxonomy of state-of-the-art open LLMs and AIFMs for clinical tasks. translated_title: 医疗健康领域的开放基础模型：生成式AI驱动个性化处方的挑战、悖论与机遇
translated_abstract: 面对专有大语言模型（LLM）取得的成功，学界对开发开放的、非专有的LLM和AI基础模型（AIFM）日益感兴趣，以便在学术、科学和非商业应用中实现透明使用。开放模型在改善医疗健康应用方面具有巨大潜力。本文对用于临床任务的最先进开放LLM和AIFM进行了全面的综述和分类。此外，我们在一个个性化处方任务上对开放权重LLM进行了实证评估，并将其与一个专有模型在有检索增强生成（RAG）和无检索增强生成两种条件下进行了比较。在100个合成患者档案上，在没有检索增强的情况下，开放权重模型在整体适宜性准确率上达到或超过了专有基线（0.810–0.850 对比 0.780），尽管两者的置信区间存在重叠；而借助检索增强，所有模型均有所提升，且……
tldr: 本文系统综述并分类了面向临床任务的开放大语言模型与AI基础模型，并通过个性化处方任务实证表明，开放权重模型可媲美甚至超越专有模型基线，检索增强生成（RAG）则能进一步提升所有模型的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive survey and taxonomy of open LLMs and AI foundation models for clinical tasks, empirically showing that open-weight models match or exceed a proprietary baseline on personalized prescription, with retrieval-augmented generation further improving all models.
